Hi Elena — thanks for the clear summary and the diagrams. High-level confirmation up front: yes, we can host the two additional clusters under your existing private control plane and support HSM-backed key material for tenant separation. A few notes and open items:

- Provisioning cadence: Pilot cluster (Q4) needs a 6–8 week lead time if we are shipping an on-prem appliance; cloud-based private in EU would be ~2–3 weeks to provision if you allow our partner region.
- Term changes: we can offer a 6-month extension with a one-time provisioning fee and a 50% pilot discount for the first 30 days to validate performance.
- KMS/HSM: integration depends on your HSM vendor. We support KMIP and AWS CloudHSM; we will need your HSM attestation doc for security review.
- Ops plan: recommend a canary routing policy (pilot cluster receives 10% production traffic for 30 days) and automatic fallback to current cluster.

I'll loop Marcus (solutions) and Lauren (security) for technical clarifications and to draft the pricing appendix.

Next steps:
1) Markus to produce a cost/timeline matrix + SOW updates by Sep 21.
2) Stellar Arrow to share HSM attestation and procurement constraints (buy vs. managed) by Sep 17.

Markus

Head of Sales, Enterprise — Redwood Inference
